title: Trump says Ukraine-Russia peace talks to begin 'immediately'
description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he spoke with Russian President Vladimir Putin and the two men agreed to end the 3-year-old war between Russia and Ukraine.

title: US President Donald Trump To Meet Russia’s Putin In Saudi Arabia, Says Ukraine Needs Elections
description: Donald Trump earlier in the day spoke to US President Putin and agreed to start Ukraine peace talks immediately.

title: Hegseth suggests Ukraine should abandon hope of winning all territory back from Russia
description: U.S. Defence Secretary says the country should instead prepare for a negotiated peace settlement to be backed up by international troops

title: Hegseth rules out Ukraine NATO membership as part of any ceasefire with Russia
description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth says the U.S. will no longer be the "primary guarantor of security in Europe," which he said must step up to secure Ukraine.

title: Ukraine’s Zelensky and Trump discuss ‘opportunities to achieve peace’ by phone
description: The call came soon after the U.S. President said he had spoken with Russia’s Vladimir Putin about starting negotiations immediately with Moscow to end the war in Ukraine

title: 'War Must End': Trump Pushes For Peace In Talks With Putin, Zelenskyy Over Ukraine
description: Trump said Russia had lost tens of millions of people in the war and both leaders wanted an end to the nearly three-year war. This came shortly after the US ruled out NATO membership for Ukraine.

title: Critical minerals deal will give Kyiv post-war ‘security shield’: US
description: Ukraine’s president said he’s ready to do a deal to open mineral resources to US investment, as he vies for the president’s backing in the war against Russia.

title: Live updates: Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin agree negotiations to end Ukraine war will begin 'immediately'
description: Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin have agreed to start negotiations to end the war in Ukraine "immediately" during a rare phone call between the leaders of the US and Russia. Follow live
